profile.description: Vanguard Australian Shares Index ETF seeks to track the return of the S&P/ASX 300 Index before taking into account fees, expenses and tax. The ETF provides low-cost exposure to companies listed on the Australian Securities Exchange. It holds around 300 of the largest companies.
